relationships.subject: noxious pinch stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: RVM On cells had a baseline firing rate of 3.810 +/− 3.762 spikes/s which increased to 9.124 +/− 9.171 spikes/s following a nociceptive pinch stimulus to the hind paw

relationships.subject: noxious pinch stimulation
relationships.evidence_quote: RVM Off cells had a relatively high baseline firing rate (7.329 +/− 0.708 spikes/s), which decreased to 2.541 +/− 0.819 spikes/s following a pinch stimulus.

relationships.subject: RVM GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The pause in Off cell firing is mediated by GABAergic input and these neurons are potently disinhibited following opioid administration.

relationships.subject: opioids
relationships.evidence_quote: are directly inhibited by local administration of opioids

key_findings: Optotagging in GABA-cre x ChR2 mice showed 27.3% of RVM On cells, 47.4% of Off cells and about 42.6-42.9% of Neutral cells are GABAergic, so each class is molecularly heterogeneous.
All Off cells not light-excited were light-inhibited, indicating strong local GABAergic input onto RVM Off cells.
